# A round approved with deferred findings

`document.json` is a line-map record whose `reviewEvidence` holds one native
review's two round files. Round 1 approved with one P2 and three P3 findings,
each filed as deferred with its follow-up; round 2 approved and lists all four
fixed in `resolvedFindings`. `golden.json` holds the text of each round's card,
in round order, as the renderer projects the record and the page draws it.
This case is the port's own, not captured from the source design.
